knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson says the facilities manager buys a standard they can check and a supplier they will not have to chase. Your hourly rate, equipment list and business age are inputs, not what the client buys.
The lesson says a re-clean promise must be something you can staff, afford and deliver within a stated time. Unlimited, undefined or impossible promises are not sound.
The lesson says a measurable claim, such as a percentage of surfaces passing a test, must be shown with the test behind it. A famous endorsement, a discount or no evidence do not support a claim.

practicalCriteria: Applies the step to a real or simulated business decision and records the outcome
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Written output of the step (plan, offer, log or record)
stopWorkCriteria: Not applicable: business guidance; stop if an offer would make an unsubstantiated or misleading claim
